defs.def: the fact of sb being away from a place where they are usually expected to be; the occasion or period of time when sb is away 缺席；不在

ex.s: Short writings missed as a result of an excused absence will be accepted.
ex.t: 因准予缺勤而错过的短写作业将被接受。

ex.s: I was back teaching after an absence of 15 years, dealing with the various kinds of "forbidden fruit" that come out of book bags.
ex.t: 在离开教学15年之后，我重新开始教书，面对着孩子们从书包里掏出的各种各样的‘禁果’。

ex.s: On the one hand, there are many different groups of people around the world who live happily in the absence of new technology.
ex.t: 一方面，世界各地有许多不同的人群在没有新技术的情况下幸福地生活。

ex.s: REFLECTING luxury prospect rural absence prediction essay network emphasis cut down keep use write read UNIT 2 LOOKING INTO THE FUTURE 1 Imagine that your 50-year-old future self has sent you a letter about your future career.
ex.t: 反思 奢侈 前景 农村 缺失 预测 论文 网络 重点 削减 保留 使用 写 读 单元 2 展望未来 1 想象你 50 岁的未来自己给你寄来了一封关于你未来职业的信。

defs.def: the fact of sb/sth not existing or not being available; a lack of sth 不存在；缺乏

ex.s: In the absence of wolves, coyote populations also grew quickly.
ex.t: 在没有狼的情况下，郊狼的数量也迅速增长。

ex.s: Only the ineducable tyro can fail to sense the presence or absence of wolves, or the fact that mountains have a secret opinion about them.
ex.t: 只有不可教育的泰罗才能感知到狼的存在或不存在，或者山脉对他们有秘密意见的事实。

ex.s: Some students look up, but there is an absence of eye contact.
ex.t: 有些学生抬头看，但没有眼神交流。

ex.s: Due to the near absence of gravity in space, we have to attach ourselves so that we don't float around.
ex.t: 由于太空中几乎没有重力，我们必须依附自己，这样我们就不会四处漂浮。
